description: Look up exchanges beyond setup's certified seven -- Autoview's integrations cover many more, filterable by paper (testnet/practice/sim, no real money), free (no Autoview subscription required), and name. Each entry's certified flag tells you whether it also works with entry (full order-type/bracket validation + connect) or only command/alert (builds the alert syntax; connect and full validation are certified-only for now) -- see connect_url to add credentials for one. Requires your Autoview account token.

free.description: filter to (true) or exclude (false) exchanges that need no Autoview subscription; omit for both

name.description: case-insensitive substring match against the exchange's display name or id, e.g. "binance"

paper.description: filter to (true) or exclude (false) paper/testnet/sim exchanges; omit for both

token.description: your Autoview account token — an av_mcp_ personal access token, generate one at /account/tokens/ on the Autoview site. Omit this if your MCP client already sends it as an `Authorization: Bearer` header (Claude Code, Cursor, and most non-browser clients do this automatically once configured).

name: catalog
